NARRATOR.style: Warm, gentle storyteller for children; read the verse with a lilting, rhythmic cadence, unhurried, with soft pauses at line ends.

KING.style: Kindly, slightly worried old king; calm, fatherly, a little slow; keep the verse rhythm.

QUEEN.style: Soft, tender, gentle queen; happy and a little surprised; light singsong.

CRAB.style: Small, quick, cheerful and wise; a bit comical, kind; brisk lilting verse.

GOODFAIRY.style: Bright, warm, kind fairy; gentle blessing tone, musical and soothing.

WITCH.style: Old, croaky, grumbling and sly, but not frightening for children; slower, with a creaky sing-song.

PRINCE.style: Brave, young, eager, friendly; clear and energetic, but still lilting.

OLDMAN.style: Old grandfatherly man, slow and low, kind; quiet storytelling.

PRINCESS.style: Young, curious, sweet girl; light and playful, clear voice.
